title: I’m leaving after one year and a half
body:
Well…. I have to admit that I used to like this app so much but I’ve been forcing myself to use it these last months because I forgot to cancel it before the renewal.

I still like the main structure, but the calendar sync doesn’t work, the routines are not easy to visualise… and honestly, sometimes it feels like talking alone.
author: misslila

title: Giving 4 because answering it was too soon
body: But, visually, the app is amazing

title: The app sell your “stories” with memes for $69,99
body: Scam, there is zero useful techniques — it is just a tool to get your money
author: Daria019383

title: Meh ..
body:
When watching the “story” format the narrated voice doesn’t complete the whole sentence sometimes. App doesn’t load anymore. 18euros a month for this app’s premium features also seems super excessive for what you get. 
I was excited to try a new app that could help with adhd. Got disappointed instead. :/
author: Mike.aymes
